Which statement about the moment of a force is not correct?
A
If an object is balanced about a pivot the resultant moment on the object must be zero.
B
The moment of a force is a measure of its turning effect.
The moment of a force about a point is equal to: force × perpendicular distance from the
C
point.
D
The moment of a force about a point increases when the perpendicular distance of the force
from the point decreases.
